about: The offertorium of the formulary “6th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal. The same chant is used in the Sexagesima formulary.

seg.tr: Make my steps sure in Your paths, that my footsteps may not be moved; incline Your ear, and hear my words; display Your wondrous mercies, You who save those who hope in You, O Lord.

a.g: my footsteps may not be moved
